title: Arm the Windows inherited-lock deadline only at its controlled contention phase
outcome: The inherited-lock budget regression verifies an expired read budget after controlled lock contention without requiring its child worker to pass pre-launch admission within two physical seconds.
acceptance: native_windows_bounded_read_reports_inheritance_lock_budget and its isolated native_windows_lock_budget_child retain exact wait/TimedOut, measured lock-wait lower bound, child reap and process-isolation assertions, using controlled deadline admission/expiry phases.
A scheduler pause before the pre-lock hook cannot cause a spawn-stage failure or missing readiness signal; production budgets and lock ownership remain unchanged without retry or ignore.
